limits: Scope is the five official native package artifact pairs plus three Windows runtime artifact pairs, including Node 24.22.2 reports nested in macOS arm64. The four separate latest-Node artifacts are outside this comparison.

The 42 reduced outcomes in 26 macOS arm64 node-load-failure cases omit kind/path/offset/original/replacement. They are matched by unchanged case name plus reported id, with the identical fixture generator blob recorded here; all other 3176 outcomes use phase plus kind/path/offset/original/replacement.

The 58 new selected/full comparison summaries are auxiliary current-build evidence with no 0.13.0 counterpart. They omit full reports, top-level jobsAttempted, workerBaselineJobs and preparedBaselineJobs; their saved jobsAttempted fields cover mutation only. Linux uses the current source debug binary; macOS arm64 uses the packaged binary.
New empty/URL-alias cases verify the current proof assertions but do not show before/after 0.13.0 results, because those cases were not retained in the previous native evidence.

Report timings and adaptive timeout values are retained as measured values, not required to match. No verdict, cancellation, timeout, error state, score or job counter is excluded as a timing difference.

Portable runner receipt paths mask known temporary project roots and capture IDs and compare test file identities by filename. Portable source assessment paths retain their relative source identities.

Public example reports embedded in summary.json are compared once after checking the standalone public-consumer-examples.json payload is its exact superset. Equal result/report.result copies and matching JSON stdout copies are also compared once.
The comparison does not rerun fixtures, prove unretained outcomes, benchmark speed or authorize publication.
